text.tspan: *** STANDARDIZED AVERAGE OF PRICE PAID INDEX COMPONENT FROM ISM MANUFACTURING & SERVICES.
**** STANDARDIZED AVERAGE OF MICHIGAN 1-YEAR, MICHIGAN 5-YEAR, AND NEW YORK FED CONSUMER INFLATION EXPECTATIONS.
SOURCE: BLS, INSTITUTE FOR SUPPLY MANAGEMENT (ISM), UNIVERSITY OF MICHIGAN, FEDERAL RESERVE BANK OF NEW YORK.
NOTES: SHADED AREAS REPRESENT U.S. NBER-DESIGNATED RECESSIONS.
